text: HANDOFF REHEARSAL FINDING (round-94, live orchestrator replacement Puccini->Rossini): plan ownership transfer does NOT re-link the planner's pane hierarchy — the Planner stayed hierarchy-linked under the dead orchestrator pane, silently routing its reports into the rate-limited void until manually fixed (codeterm agent link --pane <planner> --parent <new-orch>). SCOPE NOTE for this task (or a small sibling): 'plan transfer --to <pane>' should re-link the plan's planner_ref pane (and any live watcher panes) under the new owner in the same operation — a transfer that loses the planner's report routing is exactly the strand-the-system failure this task exists to prevent.
